keywords.def: the letter ل; its rules decide if it is said, merged, heavy or light
sun letter: the laam of al- is not said, the next letter doubles
moon letter: the laam of al- is said clearly
the Name Allah: its laam is heavy after fathah or dammah, light after kasrah

questions.q: Read «إِلَّا مَا شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ» (87:7) and name each laam rule.
questions.a: إِلَّا: a doubled laam, light; ٱللَّهُ after the fathah of شَآءَ: heavy.

questions.q: After a kasrah, the laam of Allah is ...
Laam sort (pupil PDF): label each laam in 87:1 to 12. Today's rota group recites 87:1 to 5 to the teacher.
questions.a: Moon: ٱلْأَعْلَى، ٱلْمَرْعَىٰ، ٱلْجَهْرَ، ٱلْأَشْقَى، ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ; sun: ٱلَّذِى (four times), ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ، ٱلنَّارَ; heavy Allah: 87:7.

questions.q: Extend: write the seven heavy letters from memory.
questions.a: خ ص ض غ ط ق ظ

questions.q: Stretch: find a heavy and a light laam of Allah in surahs you know.
questions.a: Heavy: قُلْ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ (112:1); light: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ (1:1).

questions.q: In «شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ» (87:7) the laam of Allah is ...
questions.a: A) heavy, after a fathah. The word before ends in a fathah (شَآءَ), so the laam is heavy.

questions.q: Think again: The same letter laam can be silent, clear, heavy or light. How can one letter have four ways to be said?
questions.a: The letters and vowels around it decide: sun or moon letter after al-, and the vowel before the Name Allah.
